{{Quote|One last thing: I am transmitting military security codes; you now have the rank of Special Projects Commander. Use it as you see fit. Do not disappoint me.|Darth Marr to the former Cipher Nine|<ref name="CtD" />}}
'''Special Projects Commander''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in use during the [[Galactic War]].

==History==
{{Quote|You are a Special Projects Commander, and you have my authority to requisition what you need. More than that will have to wait.|Darth Marr to the former Cipher Nine|<ref name="RotA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Revenge of the Archon|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>}}
In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="3638BBY">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> [[Darth Marr]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Dark Council]] granted the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of Special Projects Commander to the former [[Cipher Nine]] at the start of the Empire's involvement in the [[Conquest of Makeb|crisis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].<ref name="CtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I am transmitting military security codes to grant you the authority of Special Projects Commander. Use it or not, but I will not have you slicing my data, and it will facilitate my people's cooperation. They are not trained to obey ghosts.|Alternative dialogue between Darth Marr and the former Cipher Nine|<ref name="CtD" />}}
The rank of Special Projects Commander appeared at the start and end of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', the first expansion of the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in class-specific dialogue options between the Imperial Agent player character and Darth Marr.<ref name="CtD" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
